game.title: Bear Rush
game.tagline: Follow the river. Hunt the high country. Outrun the storm.
game.footer: A wild mountain valley, yours to explore.
menu.title: Main menu
controls.title: Field guide
controls.desktop: WASD / arrows move · Mouse looks · Shift sprints · Space / E pounces · Esc pauses
controls.touch: Touch: left stick moves · drag to look · Hunt and sprint buttons on the right
controls.goal: Hunt salmon, honey, fawns, deer, elk and moose. Run longer to build speed; steep ground gets harder to control.
controls.hazards: Only three dangers: poisonous food, a mountain slip into the trench, and bear traps. Three lives.
hint.move: Explore with WASD or the stick. The camera follows your bear across the mountain.
hint.hunt: Close in, then pounce with Space or E to hunt food and wildlife.
hint.dangers: Only poison, bear traps and trench falls cost lives. Speed rises as you keep moving.
pause.title: Take a breath
pause.message: The mountain hunt is paused. The weather will keep moving.
settings.title: Field settings
settings.privacy: Your settings and personal best stay in this browser only. No login or sign-up.
results.title: The hunt is over
results.message: The mountain is quiet again. Ready to hunt another day?
